- **Where it comes from:** Tobias posted in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he flagged it for support on #8841. Pree can see that message herself.
- **One gap:** Tobias said this was about the Plains depots on his dealer account, but he never names Marrow Fieldworks. I couldn't confirm that the dealer account is Marrow Fieldworks, so I suggested Pree check with Tobias before the call.
- **Similar number:** I also told her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket about a Door 6 scanner.

I only used the channels Pree belongs to and the public files. I didn't use the gbrain knowledge base. It refused every search because its connection isn't linked to a specific member, and fixing that needs whoever runs the gbrain server.
